name: Paine - Python 3.10.11
postCreateCommand: python -m pip install -r requirements-dev.txt && python -c "import sys, cv2, numpy, paho.mqtt.client; from importlib.metadata import version; assert sys.version_info[:3] == (3, 10, 11); assert cv2.videoio_registry.hasBackend(cv2.CAP_FFMPEG); print(sys.version); print('OpenCV', cv2.__version__, 'NumPy', numpy.__version__, 'Paho MQTT', version('paho-mqtt'))" && opencode --version
